work.abstract_text: We give an alternative proof of Mikhail Kurkov's conjecture in OEIS A263634, FORMULA of 30 March 2025 (entry revision #166, 5 November 2025), identifying its all-column array as a specialization of the Leonov–Shiryaev product-cumulant theorem (1959). The quotient method appears in xpaul (2019), and IV_ (2020) connects its first column to logarithmic polynomials. For Kurkov's quadratic recursive array we establish R(n,k)=(n-1)![t^(n-1)]F^(k)(t)/F(t), where F(t)=1+sum_(i>=1)x_i t^i/i!. Differentiating these quotients gives the recurrence directly. We also rederive classical coefficient and Appell identities, correct a factorial normalization in the source's Appell comments, and recover the exponential-polynomial exception of Craven and Csordas (1994).

work.title: An alternative proof of Kurkov's logarithmic-polynomial recursion and its Leonov–Shiryaev interpretation
